items.definition:
having the good qualities associated with a child, such as innocence or frankness
She has a childlike wonder about the world.

able or eager to communicate
She is a very communicative person and loves to talk.

able to be modified to suit a particular user or task
The software offers many customizable features.

relating to or found in deep water
Deepwater drilling operations are complex and risky.

showing an ability to understand and share the feelings of another
An empathetic listener can truly connect with others.

consisting of or characterized by fibers
Celery is a fibrous vegetable.

unfashionable and socially awkward, often with specialized interests
He has a very geeky interest in comic books.

looking exhausted and unwell, especially from fatigue, worry, or suffering
After the long journey, he looked haggard and tired.

Exaggerated, sensationalized, or overemotional.
Her reaction to the small problem was quite melodramatic.

able to be drawn back or in
The car has a retractable roof.

not claimed or taken
The lost property office was full of unclaimed items.

able to be checked or proved true
The data must be verifiable for the study to be credible.

burning fiercely; on fire
The old building was completely ablaze.

not quite right; inappropriate or out of place
He sensed that something was amiss when he saw the open door.

relating to archaeology
They discovered an important archeological site.

away from the appropriate, planned, or expected course; amiss
The plans went awry when the weather changed unexpectedly.

able to be controlled or regulated
The situation is still controllable if we act quickly.

able to be removed
The car seat has a detachable cover for easy cleaning.

easy to control or train
The once wild horse became docile after months of training.

relating to the Franciscan order of friars or nuns
He joined the Franciscan order after college.

in the form of a gas
Water can exist in solid, liquid, or gaseous states.

extremely tiring and demanding
The marathon was a grueling test of endurance.

unable to move
The accident left him immobile for several weeks.

relating to or characteristic of opera
Her voice had an operatic quality.

existing or happening in small, isolated areas; uneven or inconsistent
The internet signal was patchy in the mountains.

able to be scaled or modified to a larger or smaller size
The new software solution is highly scalable to meet future demands.

full of thorns; difficult
The issue of climate change remains a thorny problem for politicians.

not achieved or realized
He felt a sense of unfulfilled potential.

Of or denoting circles or spheres sharing the same center.
The target had several concentric rings.

relating to epilepsy
He suffered an epileptic seizure.

clean and sanitary
It's important to maintain hygienic conditions in the kitchen.

lacking human warmth or emotion
The large corporation felt very impersonal.

relating to or characteristic of a priest or the priesthood
He adopted a solemn, almost priestly, tone.

Showing or caused by malice; malicious
Her spiteful comments hurt his feelings.

Relating to or characteristic of the regions bordering on the tropics
Florida has a subtropical climate.

Not enjoying the same standard of living or rights as the majority of people in a society
The charity works to support underprivileged children.

not impressed
She remained unimpressed by his elaborate magic trick.

without supervision
Children should not be left unsupervised near the pool.

easy to talk to or deal with
She has a very approachable manner, which makes people feel comfortable.

not having sexual feelings or desires; reproducing without sexual reproduction
Some plants reproduce asexually, meaning they don't need another plant to create offspring.

neat and stylish in dress
He looked very dapper in his new suit.

resembling death; fatal
The room was filled with a deathly silence.

of or typical of a dictator; autocratic
His dictatorial style of management made him unpopular.

impartial; unbiased
A judge must remain disinterested in the outcome of the case.

made by hand
The artisan sold beautiful handcrafted jewelry.

uneven or unbalanced
The old house had a lopsided roof.

extended or stretched out
He greeted her with outstretched arms.

without any interesting or significant happenings
The journey was uneventful, and we arrived on time.

unreasonably early or late; immoral
We had to wake up at an ungodly hour to catch the flight.

not yielding profit or financial gain
The venture proved to be unprofitable, and they had to close it down.

not reported or made known
Many minor crimes go unreported.

plain; unattractive (US); cozy; simple (UK)
She had a homely but kind face.

impossible to describe
The beauty of the sunset was indescribable.

involving or concerning different religions or religious beliefs
The community organized an interfaith dialogue to promote understanding.

Relating to marriage or married people.
They sought matrimonial advice from a counselor.

impudent; disrespectful; lively
She gave him a saucy wink.

inconsiderate; careless
It was thoughtless of him to forget her birthday.

falling rapidly and in copious quantities
The torrential rain caused widespread flooding.

willing to agree or be influenced
She was amenable to the new plan.

destroying or inhibiting bacteria
This soap has antibacterial properties.

prone to arguing
He has a very argumentative personality.

pretentiously artistic
She lives in an artsy neighborhood.

able to be endured
The pain was barely bearable.

marked with a pattern of squares
He wore a checkered shirt.
